translated_text: 5. 1.38 Zabies, finally your letter arrived yesterday. I can't understand, though, why I didn't get any mail for 10 days. Besides, I always wrote immediately when I knew something definite. Little one, I won't complain anymore, but if this continues, I'll be ready for a sanatorium. It's a shame that so much valuable work is lost. The 3-day journey didn't bother me at all. But I still need 3 visas for Hungary, Ingolia, and Switzerland. The Ingolia visa was approved yesterday. I have to submit it in Zeograd, and that takes time. In my desperation, I then contacted the Foreign Ministry again. Dr. From was reviewed and returned today, I was informed. I went immediately, spoke to his representative, called Hücksprade, and now I'm sitting down in the Ministry of Finance and now I'm waiting for the letter for the National Bank. So I'm making another attempt with the approval of the flight to Gabūs; you'll only be able to do that when I tell you everything in person. It couldn't be more complicated. What you know is at most 10% of it. I'm doing it. Sometimes people fail, but they like to. But I'm just getting old. Do you cry about how happy I would be if I could put it all behind me?!!! You can be convinced that I'm doing everything. Sure, I've made mistakes too; but if you knew everything beforehand, personally. Jarüber to The telegram which I sent is of course through the letter I want to get rid of the subject of my visit to Tron today. Little one, please don't be impatient, I've been doing it for ages. Job Zot. In haci lady! "All the best, I wish you all the best for your trip. Thank you very much for everything. Unfortunately, various people didn't want us to see each other before your trip. Nevertheless, I will try to do fruitful work for you. 7.10. Evening. Mr. Bob Solben, I received the approval for the flight card. It depends on what beats I have. So I'll definitely come with Pempteup. Across, Rob.
